prompt638b_base_commit_subject: Record Fable runtime validation and commit-tag reports
prompt638b_strict_effect_gate_policy: Any explicit hard-failure status (failed/blocked/timeout/error/missing) blocks success unconditionally; when effect verification is expected, every per-cycle status must be exactly 'passed' (empty/not_run/''/null all block); when effect verification is not expected and no hard failure is present, legacy no-effect-spec flows still pass.
prompt638b_autonomous_cycle_fix_detail: _result_status now evaluates explicit failed status/classification and any non-passed effect_verification_status BEFORE the returncode==0 success shortcut, so a zero Codex returncode or success-looking JSON can no longer override an effect_verification_failed result.
prompt638b_autonomous_live_loop_fix_deta: After the cycle loop, the loop evaluates the strict effect gate over per_cycle_effect_verification_statuses (effect_expected = effect spec provided directly or via manifest). If the gate fails, final_status is forced to blocked with stop_reason=blocked_reason='effect_verification_failed' and next_action='inspect_missing_expected_effects'. per_cycle_effect_verification_statuses, effect_gate_passed, effect_gate_reason, and effect_verification_expected are all surfaced in loop state.
prompt638b_daemon_queue_fix_detail: _process_task evaluates the strict effect gate (effect_expected = plan effect_spec_path present) immediately after the loop-status check and before sandbox cleanup/commit/tag. On failure it sets stage='effect_verification_gate', status='blocked', records effect_gate_passed/effect_gate_reason, and returns early so commit/tag never runs; main() then routes the task to queue failed/.
prompt638b_tests_command: python -m unittest (3 new suites + 8 affected/related suites) = 57 tests OK

prompt638b_prompt638_batch_rerun_detail.note: Codex non-determinism flipped which task hit the brittle required_text check (Task1 passed this run, Task3 failed). The gate behaved correctly in both directions: passed-effect tasks succeeded and committed/tagged; the failed-effect task was blocked with no commit/tag and routed to failed/.

prompt638b_final_decision: Strict effect-verification success gate implemented as defense in depth across the cycle classifier (autonomous_cycle._result_status), the autonomous live loop (final status), and the daemon queue runner (commit/tag + queue routing), with a shared effect_gate helper. A failed/non-passed effect verification can no longer reach final success, sandbox commit, sandbox tag, or queue done. Proven by 3 new unit/regression suites (57 tests OK), a deterministic live-Codex regression, and a live 3-task batch rerun where the failed-effect task was correctly blocked and only passed-effect tasks committed/tagged. No main-repo commit/tag/stage and artifacts/archive untouched.
